ai.purpose: Define the structural grammar of pattern formation, pattern evolution, bifurcation, mutation, propagation, and attractor dynamics. Pattern Dynamics is the terminal synthesis module of the TriadicFrameworks canon, integrating detection, expression, governance, argumentation, and ontology into a unified dynamic model.
ai.summary: Book 9 formalizes Pattern Dynamics — the structural grammar of pattern formation and evolution. It defines trajectory types, bifurcation types, mutation types, propagation types, attractor classes, and the terminal synthesis conditions. PD integrates all upstream books to produce the final dynamic model of the TriadicFrameworks canon.

references: INV-PD-001: Trajectory Integrity — trajectories must preserve structural identity across all valid transitions.
INV-PD-002: Bifurcation Validity — bifurcations must satisfy declared preconditions and produce coherent downstream states.
INV-PD-003: Mutation Stability — mutations must preserve primitive relations unless explicitly declared as destructive.
INV-PD-004: Propagation Closure — propagation operations must remain closed under the canonical pattern dynamics grammar.
